premises.text: Medication non-adherence—patients not taking the right pill at the right time—is a costly healthcare problem
premises.evidence_span: the problem that we're solving is that of medication adherence, which basically means patients taking the right pill at the right time

premises.text: A smart pill bottle passively captures cap open/close timestamps and amount of medication removed, then compares that to the recommended dosage schedule
premises.evidence_span: Every time the patient uses the bottle, it sends two pieces of data into the cloud

premises.text: When the schedule and observed use diverge, the bottle intervenes with on-bottle lights and chimes plus automated phone or text alerts
premises.evidence_span: we have on-bottle lights and chimes, and we also have phone or text message alerts as well

premises.text: Built-in cellular connectivity lets the bottle work without Wi-Fi or Bluetooth sync and without apps, so non-tech-savvy patients can use it like a normal bottle
premises.evidence_span: patients don't have to sync it to Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. It simply works the moment they get it from the pharmacy

premises.text: Reminder notifications also solicit why patients missed doses so care parties can be alerted in real time
premises.evidence_span: when we send those reminder notifications to patients, we also ask them why they didn't take their meds

premises.text: Specialty pharma partners pay for the service while patients receive the bottle free from specialty pharmacies for high-cost specialty meds
premises.evidence_span: our business model is to partner with specialty pharma companies to distribute high-cost drugs in our bottle

premises.text: An open API enables integration with healthcare partners
premises.evidence_span: We've built this solution with an open API so we can easily integrate with all of our health care partners

domains.name: smart pill bottle adherence sensing and intervention

value.text: Improved medication adherence and patient engagement that increases refills and revenues for pharma while improving patients' lives
value.evidence_span: smart pill bottles that improve medication adherence and patient engagement

causal_links.evidence_span: improve medication adherence and patient engagement
AdhereTech will increase adherence. refills, and ultimately revenues for the pharma company
easily integrate with all of our health care partners

notes: Pain costs folded into P1 as one problem set (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). On-bottle and phone/text interventions kept as one intervention mechanism (feature cascade). Cellular/no-app ease split from sensing because speaker frames it as the core differentiator for non-adherent patients. Patents treated as IP detail on the bottle, not a separate premise. Trial and partnership traction excluded per §4.2.
